kernel: measurement/step.c (constant-instruction primitives; per-walk anchors; canonical DP exponents; 128-bit fingerprint from key bits 70..197; trail age; v10: each trail ends at its first distinguished point and at the trail cap; the walk restarts with the restart element Y_j = g^(f_j) of the restart table, j = mix((w + 1) GAMMA + t) mod 1024, t the walk's restart counter; a restarted state that is itself a DP is stored and restarted again, chained)
measurement_tool: organizer image via measurement/measure.sh (blst commit f7a88067, GCC 14.2.0, Valgrind 3.24.0 Callgrind Ir), walk runs N1=256/N2=512, MODE sizes 4096/8192 (mul, sqr, restartbench, storebench)
method: Per-step instruction counts of forced-type runs at the production header DP_BITS = 60 (no distinguished points): all-adder inputs (S=0), all-square inputs (S=1024). The per-step count is the difference of Callgrind totals between 256 and 512 rounds divided by 256 * 64 (analyze.py). One distinguished-point record is measured alone (mode storebench) and one restart alone (mode restartbench, which includes the table index and the Y_j multiplication). An all-distinguished-point run (DP_BITS 0) is not measurable under the chained rule.

reference_unit.organizer_measurement_method: REF_FUNCS=ref_mul toggle pass, (ref-512 - ref-256) / (adds-512 - adds-256) at seed 1
reference_unit.charged: 1 unit (the organizer's reference operation; the adder calls it)

restart_instructions.measurement: mode restartbench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for restart_walk on walk 0 (counter, mix, table index, Y_j multiplication, a + f_j, key_of, state clear)
restart_instructions.charged: one adder step (A_UNITS) per restart, per spec section 8

distinguished_point_record_instructions.measurement: mode storebench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for one record (fingerprint and two canonical exponents)

sort_compare_exchange_instructions.measurement: mode sortbench of step.c at 4096 (196632) and 8192 (393240) iterations: one 128-bit comparison and one 80-byte exchange per iteration

restart_table.block_layout: u64 TR, then TR Fp12 elements Y_j = g^(f_j) (fp12 struct order, as the adder table), then TR u256 f_j mod r; appended after the walks

production_walk_dp60.note: mixed walk at S=458, DP_BITS 60; the charges use the forced per-type counts

charged.restart_rule: v10: at a DP and at the trail cap the walk takes the restart element Y_j = g^(f_j), j = mix((w + 1) GAMMA + t) mod 1024, t the walk's restart counter (incremented before use), w its global index: x <- x Y_j, a <- a + f_j, b unchanged, then the key derivation and detector clear. A restart is not an adder step; it costs one multiplication and the key derivation, charged as one A_UNITS (spec section 9.1). Chained restarts are charged each.
charged.events: 66 * A_units per detected cycle (walk-through of at most 64 steps, the check step and the escape), unchanged
charged.REF_INST_note: organizer count charged 22990 (the lower of the two organizer counts: 22990 in the v9 run, 22993.106 in this run; the lower value gives the larger adder charge, which is conservative)
charged.table: accounting.py build(): per record (DP_RECORD_INST + RESTART_INST + SCATTER_INST 24 + TRANSFER_INST 100000 + OVERFLOW_INST 10); per slot of the 2^37 x 2^31 bucket table (bitonic compare-exchange 108.0030 and scan 13); one cursor reset per bucket. The 48.0 sortbench value is a kernel ring micro-benchmark and is not charged.

replica.full_visit_checks: every restart output key is compared with all visited keys (main-step states of every walk and the start states) and with all earlier restart outputs; both counts 0 in every case

native_counts: evidence/native-counts.json (uninstrumented, production DP_BITS = 60, v10 kernel, 2^20 rounds per seed)
deviations: v10 replaces the v9 restart by an adder chosen by the counter with a restart element Y_j = g^(f_j) from a separate table: a restart cannot undo the previous adder step (round-9 review).
The restart table is appended after the walks in the input file; all earlier blocks keep their content and offsets (the header version is 5).
At the production DP_BITS = 60 no restart occurs, so the native walk counts equal the v9 DP_BITS 60 counts.
The all-distinguished-point run (DP_BITS 0) is not measurable under the chained rule; the record cost is measured by storebench and the restart by restartbench.
